initial_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Commercial activities and similar' AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') ORDER BY id ASC

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing commercial unit to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare) for 15 children, subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime in Turin with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near parks.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing commercial unit.
clarifications.D: I intend to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare), subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
Cp: It depends; something suitable for the project, I guess.
